name: Arbitrade Platform

source_of_truth.resolution_policy: Resolve the current main head when a build starts, then record and build that exact 40-character commit SHA. Do not use cached branch SHAs, unmerged pull-request branches, or legacy stage-only tags as the source for a new build.
source_of_truth.immutable_build_identity: The full Git commit SHA, not the branch name, ZIP filename, or release label.

runtime.secrets_policy: DATABASE_URL is provisioned by the host. SESSION_SECRET, PASSWORD_PEPPER, and TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY are generated automatically and persisted in a private runtime secret file when not supplied by the installer. Keep that file on durable private storage and back it up. Never commit .env files, runtime secret files, production credentials, or production database exports.

release.dispatch_policy: Run from refs/heads/main only. The workflow fails closed on any other ref.
includes: pnpm-lock.yaml and installed node_modules dependency tree
Database migrations and application schema files
Browser installer, VPS scripts, and cPanel deployment guides
Exact commit/build provenance and a detached SHA-256 checksum
excludes: Production credentials, authenticator encryption keys, production user data, and production database backups

feature_scope.original_application_and_stages_1_to_3: Integrated in the canonical application source.
feature_scope.admin_customer_theme_system: Six themes are integrated: Original Arbitrade, Midnight Premium, Clean Light, Emerald Finance, Aurora Modern, and Gold Luxe. Shared semantic tokens and final portal surface styling apply to customer and administrator portals.
feature_scope.stage_4_core: Notification, notification sound/campaign, support, and related portal features are integrated.
feature_scope.stage_5_authenticator_manual_payout: TOTP authenticator enrollment and verification, recovery codes, admin/customer UI, manual payout requests, and migrations 0059-0061 are integrated.
feature_scope.portal_render_recovery: Customer and administrator workspaces include render-recovery UI.
feature_scope.payout_boundary: Payout requests are manual records and administrative status changes; they do not themselves transfer funds through a bank or blockchain provider.

acceptance.exact_commit_validation: Check the GitHub Actions results for the resolved main SHA before packaging or deploying.
acceptance.qualification: Passing a source build is not proof of hosted acceptance, financial-provider integration, or production deployment.

validation_policy.evidence_location: GitHub Actions runs attached to the exact source commit; older branch runs do not certify a newer main commit.

note: Connected coding agents and deployment platforms should read AGENTS.md, BUILD_SOURCE.json, and BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md; resolve refs/heads/main at build time; and use the root Dockerfile for container builds.
